$comment: The published theme-token names (DOC-034, docs/55 decision 3). This file is the answer to 'what are the token names now?' — a question docs/55 said was cheap to answer before the first release and impossible after it, and which the first release then answered by default. These names are public API: a host reads them to build a theme picker and sets the ones it cares about, so renaming one breaks every consumer stylesheet that set it. tools/check-theme-tokens.py asserts webapp/embed.js still advertises exactly this set, so a rename is a deliberate, visible diff here rather than a silent drift there.
naming: camelCase in JS, kebab-case with the --oc- prefix in CSS
